summary: Backend-only test for Tıbb-ul Furkan Form Submissions feature. All 9 pytest cases PASSED (9/9, 100%). Verified: POST /api/form-submissions returns 200 with generated id+created_at and echoes required fields (ad_soyad, dogum_tarihi, cinsiyet, rahatsizliklar); GET list returns the created submission; GET /{id} returns the submission; GET unknown id returns 404; minimal-payload create works (only ad_soyad required). AI analysis at POST /api/form-submissions/{fid}/analyze returns 200 with {ai_analysis, signals}, ai_analysis is >=100 chars Turkish text, contains the EXACT required phrase 'Lütfen seans alınız' AT/NEAR THE END (within last 400 chars). Persisted ai_analysis is retrievable via GET. Analyze of unknown id returns 404. DELETE returns {ok: true} and subsequent GET returns 404. No MongoDB _id leak on any endpoint. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is currently functional (no 503 budget errors during this run); Claude Sonnet 4.6 via emergentintegrations call completed successfully.

minor.issue: build_system_message() is rebuilt on every analyze request (includes full DISEASE_PATTERNS + CAUSE_CATEGORIES blocks). Minor performance/cost optimisation: cache the string at module load.

User prompt still ends with '>>> Yukarıdaki yapıya uygun şekilde 5 bölümden oluşan analizi hazırla.' (server.py line ~684) which contradicts the new free-form requirement and the system prompt that no longer enforces 5 sections. This stale instruction may bias the LLM toward 5-section output. Recommend removing or rewording to 'Akıcı bir analiz hazırla'.
FormSubmissionCreate has no validation for ad_soyad length / non-empty after stripping. Empty string '' is accepted as a valid submission.

action_items: Optional: Remove the stale '5 bölümden oluşan analizi hazırla' line in server.py analyze_form user prompt (~line 684) — system prompt already requests free-form output ending with 'Lütfen seans alınız.' so this line is contradictory.
Optional: Validate ad_soyad is non-empty (min_length=1 after .strip()) in FormSubmissionCreate to prevent garbage submissions.
Optional: Cache build_system_message() result at module import (it is deterministic) to avoid rebuilding the long KB string on each analyze call.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line ~684: user_text ends with '>>> Yukarıdaki yapıya uygun şekilde 5 bölümden oluşan analizi hazırla.' — contradicts the updated free-form spec where 5-section structure was removed.
server.py analyze_form correctly maps Budget/credit errors to HTTP 503 with a friendly Turkish message (good).
All form-submissions endpoints correctly project away MongoDB _id via {'_id': 0} (good).
build_system_message() correctly instructs the model to end with the literal phrase 'Lütfen seans alınız.' — verified by live LLM response in this test run.
seed_data_creation: Tests create and delete one TEST_Mehmet Yılmaz form-submission plus one minimal TEST_Min User submission per run. Both are cleaned up via DELETE before exit. No residual seed data left in DB.

rca_of_issue: No bug. The 'Lütfen seans alınız' phrase requirement is satisfied by the LLM: knowledge_base.build_system_message() ends with an explicit instruction telling the model to append the phrase verbatim on a new line. The live Claude Sonnet 4.6 call honored this in tests — the phrase was found within the last 400 chars of the ai_analysis.
